notes.title: Version 2.5
notes.content:
Uninstall and then reinstall the game to play this version. Old saves are not compatible.

- family and development mode can be disabled
- statistics: sales data graph for each article
- loyalty card management
- promotion management
- invest in advertising
- store ranking
- some adjustments 
- Fixing bugs.

Inform us if you encounter any bugs on the forum. Thank you.

notes.title: Update for September
notes.content:
For the future update (September), added the possibility to disable game modes (family, development). And other surprises. 
Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: What changes for the next "version 2" for this week.
notes.content:
Please wait to start a new game. Thank you.

- Choice of budget at the beginning of the game
- More gain for the development part
- Adjusting the music volume
- 20% more customers entering the store
- Family gauges are decreasing at a slower rate
- Customers specify the name of the console, game or accessory, when it is 
  missing or too expensive.
- Competitors' prices do not change when the game resumes
- Customers no longer get stuck in front of the door
- Fixed bug: items that disappear and then return from stock
- fewer days of illness
- Security now costs $20 
- Fixing small bugs
